staged_regression_appendix.mechanism: poll_runtime samples now, then deliver() can advance the checkpoint service clock while consuming canonical frames. Passing the older now to p4_cs_poll triggers strict backward-time rejection, releases the snapshot, latches slot 1 failure (failed_slots=2), and subsequently emits GCP1 abort reason 5 while the host continues.
staged_regression_appendix.minimal_patch: Resample millis() immediately before p4_cs_poll after delivery callbacks. Service and transfer validation, deadlines and wire format are unchanged.
staged_regression_appendix.fixture_scope: Actual C adapter and checkpoint service; instrumented engine advances the virtual timer by 1 ms inside D_ReceiveTic while two canonical frames are delivered through public submit/poll APIs; virtual queued transport with real SHA verification.

recorded_results.baseline: elapsed=22 failed_slots=2 retained=0 packets=0; normal regression exits -6 on snapshot-survival assertion. Separate baseline diagnostic mode verifies released snapshot, subsequent on-wire reason 5, removed guest and continuing host.
recorded_results.candidate: elapsed=22 failed_slots=0 retained=1 packets=1; transfer repairs a dropped chunk, completes real SHA verification and retains the snapshot until retirement. Genuinely reversed external time still aborts with reason 5.
recorded_results.sanitizers: Recorded ASan/UBSan and strict compiler warning checks pass nine adapter groups and twelve unchanged service groups (34,645 service assertions).

staged_regression_appendix.device_relation: The observed 0.69 CAPTURE followed 1.632 seconds later by reason 5 before guest restore is consistent with this reproduced defect. Device logs do not expose the internal service timestamps; the exact hardware time crossing and device causality remain inferred until a corrected-device retest.
